publicSeams.description: Platform integration entry point for organization business-unit membership routes and behavior.
Service contract for business-unit membership lifecycle, member-target validation, and export projection reads.

dependsOn.description: Memberships validate owning and member business units through the organizationBusinessUnits public service seam.
Tenant-admin membership routes require an active tenant session context.

breakingChangeRisks: Changing membership role taxonomy or member-target validation can break exports and future access/reporting slices.
Individual member targets are intentionally deferred until an approved individual/person record seam exists.
